releases.notes: LED test at power-on, switched on from the Shift Light app (1.7). Boards on build 5 can install this from the app over Bluetooth. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Firmware updates over Bluetooth from the Shift Light app (1.6 or newer). This one needs USB; later ones can come from the app. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Brings back VTP/1 for data loggers, which build 3 dropped. Update keeps your thresholds and colours.
Protocol v3, the one firmware every car's board now runs. Update keeps your thresholds and colours. Needs Shift Light app 1.5 or the web app 2.0.

The R53 Shift Light K-line + CAN board (rev C, XIAO ESP32-S3) joins the flasher. C3 board: remote CAN frames never read as RPM, VTP loss counts only its own frames, Identify no longer pauses the board, and a new RPM id or scale drops the old reading.
Silent app handshake: changing settings needs Android app 1.2 or newer.
